analysis: frozen shared-score transport under topology multiplicity

evaluation.common_eligibility: at least two originally observed and structurally valid source roles
evaluation.thresholds: outer-training score quantiles are recomputed at each multiplicity without labels

frozen_score.fit_data: m=1 outer-training rows pooled across product, nested Dirichlet, global cautious, and PACT; method identity excluded

methods.nested_unaware: nested Dirichlet composition receives all geometry copies and ignores registration
methods.pact_all_merge: all opinions share one registered parent
methods.pact_registered: geometry copies inherit the geometry parent; the original two-component topology is retained
methods.pact_singleton: every copied opinion receives a separate parent

multiplicity_definition: total geometry-opinion count including the original
outcome_rule: retain every result and sign; manuscript claim strength follows the frozen result
